# Feature Specification: Phase 16: Current-year parallel mirror and cutover preparation

<!-- SPECKIT_LEVEL: 3 -->

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Phase 16 moves the migration one step forward against the goal in section 2 and the exit gate in section 5. The Operator approves the result before the next phase starts.

**Key Decisions**: All Moneybird writes go through moneybird-guard with the gate passed and Operator approval recorded, phase evidence stays in the git ignored `migration-workspace/`, and Jortt remains read-only.

**Critical Dependencies**: The entry criteria in Phase Context hold and the previous phase exit gate has passed.

## Phase Context

This is **Phase 16** of the Jortt to Moneybird migration template specification.

**Scope Boundary**: The phase stops at the entry criteria below and the exit gate in section 5. Work beyond the exit gate becomes its own phase packet.

**Entry criteria** (from the phase reference):

Historical years through the approved boundary passed. The Operator approved a positive minimum parallel cycle count or duration, rationale, numeric stop thresholds, and rollback triggers.

**Dependencies**:
- Previous phase exit gate passed, or None for Phase 0
- Mechanisms in scope for this phase: M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M10, M12
- Source contract: [../../../sk-moneybird-accountant/references/migration/phases-10-to-16.md](../../../sk-moneybird-accountant/references/migration/phases-10-to-16.md) and [shared mechanisms](../../../sk-moneybird-accountant/references/migration/shared-mechanisms.md)

**Phase outputs** (from the phase reference):

Parallel comparison reports, minimum-cycle rationale, planned freeze date, delta schema, numeric rollback trigger table, rehearsal evidence, and cutover readiness packet without a live GO or NO-GO decision.

**Changelog**:
- When this phase closes, refresh the matching file in ../changelog/ using the parent packet number plus this phase folder name.

<!-- ANCHOR:problem -->
## 2. PROBLEM & PURPOSE

### Problem Statement
At the start of Phase 16: Current-year parallel mirror and cutover preparation, the migration cannot move on because the purpose of this phase is not yet met. Left unhandled, the phase would either write unverified data into Moneybird or leave the migration without recorded evidence.

### Purpose

**Goal** (from the phase reference):

Compare the existing source administration and Moneybird mirror through a configured parallel period and prepare a complete cutover delta. The Implementer drafts the parallel comparison and delta schema, and the Verifier independently checks the delta for Phase 16.

The exit gate in section 5 passes, the recorded evidence sits in `migration-workspace/`, and the Operator approves so the next phase may start.
<!-- /ANCHOR:problem -->

---

<!-- ANCHOR:scope -->
## 3. SCOPE

### In Scope
- Following the Phase 16 section of [../../../sk-moneybird-accountant/references/migration/phases-10-to-16.md](../../../sk-moneybird-accountant/references/migration/phases-10-to-16.md) and the shared mechanisms in [../../../sk-moneybird-accountant/references/migration/shared-mechanisms.md](../../../sk-moneybird-accountant/references/migration/shared-mechanisms.md)
- Running the actions in the order set out in plan.md section 4
- Applying the guard route for any Moneybird write, as set out in the tool route in plan.md section 4
- Reading, not writing, Jortt data needed as input

### Out of Scope
- Any Jortt write. Jortt is read-only in every phase
- Work owned by other phases. Each phase stays inside its own exit gate
- Extra cleanup beyond the phase exit gate. It becomes its own phase packet instead

### Inputs

**Phase inputs** (from the phase reference):

Current-year source records, mirror reports, bank evidence, filing calendar, minimum parallel cycle or duration, planned Operator-set freeze date, compensation plan, rollback thresholds, and M6 access evidence.

Read each input from Jortt or from the previous phase. Jortt stays read-only.

### Files to Change

| File Path | Change Type | Description |
|-----------|-------------|-------------|
| `migration-workspace/[phase evidence folder]/` | Create | Phase evidence, for example exports, guard reports and approval notes |
| `migration-workspace/[evidence index file]` | Create | Index of every evidence file with its date, purpose and gate |
<!-- /ANCHOR:scope -->

## 4. REQUIREMENTS

### P0 - Blockers (MUST complete)

| ID | Requirement | Check |
|----|-------------|-------|
| REQ-001 | SG-16.1: Derive the next work year from the configured start date and last locked year. | next historical year is the first unlocked year at or after the configured start year 1, current mirror year is the actual calendar year only when it is at or after the configured start date and is not locked 1, hard-coded current-year labels 0. |
| REQ-002 | SG-16.2: Complete configured parallel comparisons. | a positive minimum cycle count or duration and rationale are approved in `MIGRATION_CONFIG` as `parallel.cycles_required`, completed cycles meet that minimum 100%, unresolved differences 0. |
| REQ-003 | SG-16.3: Prepare the source freeze and final delta contract. | Operator-set freeze date and time, delta schema, and source-total method recorded 100%. The actual freeze, its last source key, and delta capture occur in Phase 17. |
| REQ-004 | SG-16.4: Prepare objective rollback controls. | numeric trigger thresholds and named decision owner 100%, rehearsal scenarios complete 100%, post-cutover write reconciliation rehearsal 100%. |
| REQ-005 | SG-16.5: Run the agent route. | M12 checks: work units with Verifier PASS or Operator disposition 100%, parallel delta checks independently pass 100%, payload-scan prohibited fields 0, boundary canary at phase entry passed 1, Final review PASS 1. |

<!-- ANCHOR:success-criteria -->
## 5. SUCCESS CRITERIA

**Exit gate** (from the phase reference):

Configured minimum cycles or duration met 100%, final delta plan complete 100%, unexplained differences 0, unknown writes 0, rollback trigger coverage 100%, rehearsal scenarios pass 100%, cutover readiness packet complete 1, live GO or NO-GO decisions recorded 0.

M12 gate: work units with Verifier PASS or Operator disposition 100%, parallel delta checks independently pass 100%, Final review PASS 1, payload-scan prohibited fields 0, boundary canary at phase entry passed 1.

- **SC-001**: The exit gate above passes with its evidence filed under `migration-workspace/`
- **SC-002**: Zero stop conditions from section 6 stay open at close and the Operator approval is recorded in `decision-record.md`
<!-- /ANCHOR:success-criteria -->

---

<!-- ANCHOR:risks -->
## 6. RISKS & DEPENDENCIES

**Stop conditions** (from the phase reference):

No positive minimum cycle count or duration, no rationale, no numeric rollback threshold, source activity after the planned freeze without a delta method, missing rollback owner, M6 failure, or unresolved post-cutover write state.

Stop on any M12 stop event.

If any stop condition above fires, stop at once, record it in `decision-record.md` and clear it before any further Moneybird write.

| Type | Item | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|------|--------|------------|
| Dependency | The entry criteria in Phase Context | Phase cannot start | Clear the entry check or wait. Do not force the phase |
| Dependency | Previous phase exit gate | Blocks the phase start | Resume the previous phase and close its gate first |
| Risk | A stop condition from the phase reference | High | Stop, record it in `decision-record.md` and resolve it before any further Moneybird write |
| Risk | Unrecorded Moneybird write | High | Route every write through moneybird-guard with the gate passed and Operator approval recorded |
<!-- /ANCHOR:risks -->

---

## 7. NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

### Performance
- **NFR-P01**: The phase finishes in one working session or the Operator splits it at a recorded checkpoint

### Security
- **NFR-S01**: Jortt stays read-only and credentials never land in tracked files, only in the guard environment

### Reliability
- **NFR-R01**: The packet is resumable at any point. The resume rule in plan.md section 7 restores the last safe step

---

## 8. EDGE CASES

### Data Boundaries
- Empty input: the entry check fails and the phase waits instead of writing partly migrated data
- Maximum length: a batch above the agreed size is split, and work beyond the phase exit gate becomes a new phase packet

### Error Scenarios
- External service failure: stop, run the rollback procedure in plan.md section 7, and record it before retrying
- Network timeout: resume with the resume rule in plan.md section 7, dry run first, then repeat the failed step and append the evidence
